meta.notes: Defines the sound event msm_starter:music_disc.ruby_waltz. It plays the vanilla file records/cat for now: choose Import assets, then Sounds, and pick your own .ogg (for example ruby_waltz.ogg; it is stored as sounds/ruby_waltz.ogg in this namespace), then change name to msm_starter:ruby_waltz. stream: true plays long music without loading it all at once.
